# ADR-3033: A03: Prefer prepared statement coverage for datastore 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Mixed ORM and raw SQL increases miss rate.

## Decision

Teams SHOULD prefer prepared statement coverage for datastore 9 (A03-9) when reviewing data-access PRs.

## Consequences

Static checks gate new raw SQL.
